meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自动实验把模型或流程的评分逐步顶高
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为模型或流程的分数头疼,想用自动实验挑出更稳妥的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run experiments to push model or pipeline scores steadily higher
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automatic experiments to improve a model or pipeline and avoid overfitting.

howto.what: Claude 会充当协调者,围绕一个可修改的产物和评分器反复做实验:用假设树保存假设与证据,派子代理在隔离 git worktree 中各测一条,只有通过留出测试评估的改动才并入最佳版本。
howto.when: 当你要反复迭代改进一个可修改的产物(如提升模型 eval 分数、优化 agent、调数据或 prompt 管线等),并且有自动评分方式时触发;只想要一次性修复时不适用。

say.text: 帮我把这个 benchmark 的分数提上去,别过拟合 dev 集
say.note: Claude 先和你确认目标与 dev/test 评估器

say.text: 用 Arbor 优化这个 agent harness,跑 12 轮搜索
say.note: 进入协调者循环,预算 12 轮

say.text: 把这个候选改动跑一遍 held-out 测试,过了再并入
say.note: 通过合并闸门才成为新的最佳版本

howto.what_en: Claude acts as coordinator: it runs many experiment cycles on a modifiable artifact and an evaluator, keeps a hypothesis tree, sends subagents to test hypotheses in git worktrees, and merges only changes that pass a held-out test.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to iteratively improve a scorable artifact — model eval, agent harness, pipeline — over many experiments; a one-shot fix doesn't need it.

say_en.text: Raise this benchmark's score without overfitting the dev set
say_en.note: Claude first confirms the objective and dev/test evaluators

say_en.text: Optimize this agent harness with Arbor over 12 cycles
say_en.note: Runs the coordinator loop with a 12-cycle budget

say_en.text: Run the held-out test on this candidate and merge it if it passes
say_en.note: Only test-confirmed changes become the new best
